buyback_accretion_analysis.why: WHF retired 7.6% of its shares in three quarters, all far below NAV. Buyback accretion can hold NAV/share flat while the underlying book erodes.
buyback_accretion_analysis.method: accretion_per_share = shares_repurchased x (NAV/share at start of quarter - average price paid) / shares outstanding at quarter end. Average price paid = repurchase dollars / shares repurchased, from the Consolidated Statements of Changes in Net Assets 'Purchases of common stock, net of offering costs' row.

cumulative_3_quarters.interpretation: Of the +$0.359/share NAV move from 9/30/2025 to 6/30/2026, approximately $0.332 (92%) is mechanical accretion from repurchasing stock at a ~36% discount to NAV. Gross of buybacks the book was essentially FLAT (+$0.03).
cumulative_3_quarters.yoy_version: Over the four quarters 6/30/2025 -> 6/30/2026 reported NAV/share fell 11.82 -> 11.77 (-$0.05). Gross of the ~$0.332 of buyback accretion the underlying NAV/share fell roughly $0.38, i.e. about -3.2%.
cumulative_3_quarters.caveat: The Financial Highlights table independently reports 'Purchases of common stock' of +$0.15/share for the six months ended 6/30/2026 (10-Q acc 0001104659-26-093465), against my computed 0.083+0.065 = $0.148 for the same two quarters — the method reconciles to the filing's own per-share attribution within $0.002.

realization_washout_analysis.why: When an impaired asset is written off, its unrealized depreciation becomes realized and the cost basis resets, so FV/cost improves with zero credit improvement.

cumulative_4_quarters_2025Q3_to_2026Q2.note: realized losses of 17,896 were recognized while unrealized depreciation reversed by only 12,452 — the realized losses are predominantly transfers out of the unrealized bucket.

realization_washout_analysis.single_largest_washout_quarter: 2025Q4: net realized -11,348 against net change in unrealized +13,123 — the classic signature of writing off / exiting impaired positions.
realization_washout_analysis.interpretation_evidence_only: The $12,409 reduction in the unrealized depreciation balance is smaller than the $17,896 of realized losses taken over the same four quarters, and the cost basis shrank 10.9%. On this arithmetic the FV/cost improvement is consistent with impaired assets LEAVING the book rather than surviving assets being marked up. Counter-evidence that some marks did recover: 2026Q2 posted +5,779 of net unrealized appreciation on only -51 of realized. Adjudication is not performed here.
realization_washout_analysis.contrary_datapoint: Camarillo Fitness Holdings, LLC (f/k/a Honors Holdings, LLC) first lien term loan: amortized cost UNCHANGED at 10,231 across both period ends while fair value fell 5,354 -> 2,563. That is a fresh markdown on a static cost basis, i.e. genuine further impairment, not washout.

incentive_fee_mechanics.income_incentive_fee: Quarterly in arrears on Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income. Hurdle Rate 1.75%/quarter (7.00% annualized). 100% catch-up between 1.75% and 2.1875% (8.75% annualized), then 20% of everything above.
incentive_fee_mechanics.pik_provision_verbatim_paraphrase: The portion of the incentive fee attributable to DEFERRED INTEREST (such as PIK interest or original issue discount) is paid to the adviser, with interest from the date of deferral, ONLY IF AND TO THE EXTENT the Company actually receives such interest IN CASH; any accrual is reversed if the interest is reversed on write-off.
incentive_fee_mechanics.significance: This is a direct structural mitigant against the incentive to hold PIK income high — the adviser does not get paid on PIK until it is collected in cash. It is the specific mechanic the mark-support thesis would predict to be ABSENT.
incentive_fee_mechanics.look_back_cap: Incentive Fee Cap: cumulative incentive fees over the current quarter plus 11 preceding quarters (12-quarter Incentive Fee Look-back Period) may not exceed 20.0% of Cumulative Pre-Incentive Fee Net Return, which INCLUDES cumulative realized losses and cumulative unrealized depreciation. Fees above the cap are deferred up to three years and may be recouped.
incentive_fee_mechanics.capital_gains_fee: 20% of cumulative realized gains net of realized losses and unrealized depreciation, determined annually.
incentive_fee_mechanics.voluntary_waivers: On 2025-11-10 WhiteHorse Advisers voluntarily agreed to reduce the income incentive fee rate from 20.00% to 17.50% for the two quarters ending 12/31/2025 and 3/31/2026. On 2026-05-07 it extended the same reduction to the quarter ending 6/30/2026. Amounts waived: 142 (2026Q2), 312 (2026 H1). Waivers RAISE reported GAAP NII.
incentive_fee_mechanics.fees_paid_despite_losses: The filing explicitly acknowledges the Company may pay an incentive fee in a quarter in which it incurs a loss, subject to the cap.
